debates.rationale: CPI inflation surprise signals persistent price pressures, likely triggering hawkish Fed response and rate-hike expectations. Positive bias reflects inflation-risk dominance and policy tightening implications favoring higher rates.

CPI surprise to upside forces hawkish Fed pivot, reducing probability of near-term easing. Inflation remains sticky, constraining dovish case despite any growth concerns. Hawkish policy stance headwind for risk assets.

Hawkish Fed pivot typically strengthens USD, pressuring XAUUSD lower, but stagflationary CPI surprise supports gold as inflation hedge. Oil demand concerns from rate hikes offset by potential supply disruptions from geopolitical tension. Net positive for commodities but with elevated volatility.
